item.title: Steve Kornacki: What Democrats' sky-high turnout in the Texas primary does — and doesn't — mean for November
item.description: Democrats in Texas are feeling enthusiastic about their voters’ enthusiasm — and for good reason.

item.title: House Oversight Committee votes to subpoena Pam Bondi over Epstein files
item.description: The Republican-led House Oversight Committee voted to subpoena Attorney General Pam Bondi over the Justice Department's handling of the Epstein files.

item.title: Iran retaliation is isolating Tehran and angering Mideast neighbors, sources say
item.description: Iran’s decision to retaliate across the Middle East has amounted to a strategic mistake, isolating Tehran and angering neighbors, sources tell NBC News.

item.title: Inside the underground nerve center of Israel's first responders
item.description: NBC News visited the main nerve center for Israel’s primary emergency service, Magen David Adom, as the country was on stand by for retaliatory drone strikes.

item.title: Trump administration could order U.S. manufacturers to make more munitions amid Iran war
item.description: WASHINGTON — Concerns over depleting munitions used to defend American forces in the Middle East may lead the Trump administration to force defense companies to produce more weaponry quickly, according to three people familiar with the discussions

item.title: Trump officials consider arming Kurdish opposition against Iran's regime
item.description: WASHINGTON — Trump administration officials are in discussion with Kurdish leaders in northern Iraq and northwestern Iran about potentially arming groups opposed to the Iranian regime, according to three people with knowledge of the discussions and an Iraqi Kurdish official

item.title: Who is set to be in charge in Iran now that Khamenei is dead? A powerful hard-line military corps
item.description: The U.S.-Israeli attack that ended Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s iron-fisted rule of Iran also created a power vacuum in the Islamic Republic for the first time in decades, with a group of clerics convening to cast their votes on who would succeed him.

item.title: Shipping slows through Strait of Hormuz, threatening to snarl global trade
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz, normally jammed with oil tankers and cargo ships, has been nearly emptied by the war in the Middle East.

item.title: NBC News poll shows most voters disapprove of how Trump has handled Iran
item.description: NBC News’ Monica Alba, Richard Engel and Courtney Kube report on the latest U.S. actions in the Middle East as a new NBC News poll reveals a majority of registered voters say President Trump should not have taken action in Iran.

item.title: Thousands of Americans stranded in Middle East
item.description: WIth Iran continuing its drone and missile attacks in the Middle East, travel has been chaotic. The Trump administration says it is chartering flights and opening up seats on military planes to help stranded Americans. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.
